steps.text: We spend our entire lives flying. Has anyone ever stopped to wonder where we will end up?
The humid breeze from back home, and the saline taste it leaves in the mouth.
The scorching sun, the unbearably high temperatures, the marks the hustle and bustle leave behind on the skin, and the air currents that gather in the open, spacious city.
I've experienced it. I've experienced it all.
Maybe someday I will make it back to that place.
10:10 A.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Cabin No. 2, Operator Rest Area

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Okay, it's up to you to let everybody else know, Mr. Elysium!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I've already talked to the Logistics Department about the ingredients we need, and I'll figure out the menu with FEater.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: We should be able to make most homemade fare ourselves, but we'll need help with the more complicated dishes...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, right! Leizi said she could help us write the invitations. Her handwriting is pretty, and her stroke movements are so beautiful and swift. Just watching her write makes me want to learn calligraphy!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, you certainly have everything in order. I didn't expect Miss Leizi to offer her help.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We need to contact the Yan and Lungmen operators on this list who are currently out in the field, correct? Just leave it to me. I'll get every last one of them!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I'm so glad you're helping us, Mr. Elysium.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I didn't expect there to be so many people from the old country here at Rhodes Island. Hehe, I really love that feeling of everyone coming together. It makes everything so lively, having so many people in one place.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I wonder if the people out there right now will make it back on time, though... I really hope they do... Hm, I guess it's probably going to be difficult, but there's always a chance!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, of course, we welcome everyone! Would you like to join us, Mr. Elysium? You can bring your friends with you, too. The more the merrier!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Really? That's wonderful. I'll bring as many as I can. This is an opportunity not to be missed.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The more the merrier, right? That's what we're good at!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Ahaha... of course, we welcome all of you, but please don't go overboard, either. Dr. Kal'tsit would probably yell at us.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't worry. I know our limits.
If you're afraid of getting yelled at, you'd better not invite this guy.
If courting disaster a talent, then he is the most talented person I've ever seen.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Thorns, good morning!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Morning.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, come now. We both know you aren't much better than me when it comes to courting disaster.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Do remember who it was that wrecked the steel plates in the connect area last time! Why did I have to bear the brunt of Miss Closure's tirade?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: How would I know?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Wasn't it because you brought her little robot up to the deck and it shattered to pieces?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Th-That wasn't my fault! Andreana was shooting her inkballs there. She caught me off guard, and that's how the thing slipped out of my hand!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Eh? Wait a minute, why would Miss Andreana do something like that on the deck? She doesn't seem like the kind of person who would do that...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: She was trying out her crossbow. I added something to emulate the feeling of shooting a Laterano gun.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So it was your fault after all! No wonder that gun nut was so excited!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What's wrong... Huh? Who's there?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh! Sinthe!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Why are you hiding over there? Come here!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, are you afraid of these two? It's okay, don't be shy! They aren't scary. Besides, I'm here!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Um, Purestream, don't pull on my sleeve... I'm coming.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...Sorry, am I interrupting? There's something I wanted to talk to Mr. Thorns about. If it isn't a good time right now, I can come back later...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not at all. We're all coworkers. There is no need to be so formal.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: She's here for you.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I certainly didn't expect a girl to willingly talk to you, with that poker face of yours. This really puts my mind at ease.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...It's none of your business.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: What is it that you need?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Right. I'm sorry to bother you right now, Mr. Thorns.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: There's something I wanted to ask you about maintaining my weapon...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hm, interesting. Is this guy known for maintaining his weapons?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now that you mention it, it's about time I get my communicator fixed.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Tell me, do you think Miss Closure will forgive me and make some enhancements to my communicator if I bring her a present after my next mission?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: If you bring her something garlic flavored, I can guarantee you she won't.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Did you bring your weapon? Let me take a look.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Thank you! It's right here.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: My weapon's Arts Unit is a little different compared to what other casters use. It's a little more complicated to maintain the parts inside... Oh, please be careful. The trigger is kind of loose.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It's old.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Is this the kind of Arts Unit they use in Ursus?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...Yes. It belonged to my father.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I asked Old Mr. Hellagur about it, and he told me to take good care of the staff, otherwise it could affect its performance in the future.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: He also told me you can mix good reagents for weapon maintenance.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: And, um... I'm very sorry to ask you this out of the blue, but if it's okay with you, could you—

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Could you please help me... huh?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Yes, I will help you.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I've actually just come up with a new idea. If you can trust me with your weapon, I can give it a try.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Eh, um, y-yes. T-Thank you.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Isn't that great, Sinthe?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You'd better not test anything weird on her weapon. I'm not doubting the effectiveness of your reagents, but every time you make something new, they always turn out pretty weird.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It'll be fine this time.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: How can you be so sure?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I've already tested it on your weapon.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Huh? Ahhhh!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'm just kidding.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Are they always like this...? They seem to get along really well.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yeah, they're both from Iberia. Iberian operators are pretty much all really good friends.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: It's a wonderful feeling to meet people from back home when you are so far away.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I was very happy when Miss FEater, the famous movie star, gave me her autograph! She's a huge celebrity where I'm from, and all of my friends and neighbors love her!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: And now we're so close that we go shopping together!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, right, and Miss Leizi too. She may look scary, but she's actually a really nice person.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Have you seen what she does to broken video monitors? She just whacks them like this. I thought that'd break them, but that's how she fixes them!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Isn't that how you fix electronics? You just need to hit them when they aren't working well.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: That's true. Everyone back home does that. It works like a charm.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Yep. If it doesn't work, whack it a few more times.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yep, exactly!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: I see, so they are old friends back home.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, cheer up. Don't look like that!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I know, you're thinking about Zima, Leto, and the others, right?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I'll come with you next time. I'm friends with Leto. You two will hit it off right away! Once you get to know each other, it'll be much easier to talk to them.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...Yeah. I hope so too. I'll have to talk to them sooner or later...

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Thanks, Purestream.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh... You don't have to thank me. It makes me embarrassed.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Ah, what a wonderful display of friendship. Dazzling, don't you agree? I love seeing these situations play out before my eyes.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: This reminds me of how shy I used to be when I first got here...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Are you sure you were ever shy?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Of course I was! Stop ruining my moment!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Even I need time to ease into things. Besides, Rhodes Island used to be a very different place. We didn't have that many people on board, and everyone was a lot more serious than they are now.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Eh, really? I can see Dr. Kal'tsit being strict. She still is. But how about everyone else? How was Miss Closure? And what about Amiya?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, you know how Dr. Kal'tsit is. As for Miss Closure, since she was always busy, we rarely ever got a glimpse of her. She only slowed down a little after she got everything on the ship in order, before getting busy again with her robots.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hm... Let's see. It was about two years ago when I first got here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Amiya was still a kid back then. She was a bit shorter, like a sprout.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, I have to say. She still isn't quite an adult, even though her expression is a lot different now.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: What was the Doctor like two years ago?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Eh, was the Doctor here too?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I believe the Doctor joined shortly before we did.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Really? But I thought the Doctor was one of the founders of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well... that's a tough question to answer.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: To tell you the truth, I'm not entirely sure what happened myself. I think something happened to the Doctor before I got here, and not many people know about it. The captain wouldn't tell me about it, either.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Anyway, I never met the Doctor until everything that went down in Lungmen. Ace certainly did raise the topic from time to time, though.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: In any case, I'd say the way things are now isn't too bad. Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit, and the Doctor all get along with each other, and we're bringing in more and more operators. Things are going to get even busier here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: From that point of view, I think I made the right decision when I decided to stay. I've had my fill of gloomy, boring places.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I may not be a Messenger, but I still get the chance to travel to different places, see different sights, and have a place to call home. That's more than enough for me.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Speaking of which, have you been back since you left?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Where?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Iberia.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not even once!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Even if we wanted to go back... it's not quite possible, is it?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Both of you are from Iberia, right?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I haven't heard much about that place. What is it like? If you can't go back, don't you miss home?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Uh, well, I guess I do miss Iberia a little.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I guess I shouldn't have asked.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: No, it's not really a big deal. It's just, how should I say this? Yeah, there's not really much worthy of mention there, now that I think about it.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, don't look like that. It's not as if I have any painful memories of the place, but... yeah, Iberia was pretty boring for me.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Even though it's your homeland...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yeah, it's boring. It's depressing to no end.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I couldn't live there, and so I left. That's all there is to it. Aside from that, I guess it wasn't so bad.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: That's what you think.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: To us Ægirians, Iberia isn't a very friendly place.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh... I've heard a little about that, but I don't know much about it. There weren't a lot of Ægirians where I lived, after all.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Most Ægirians lived on the streets in the city outskirts or stuck it out near the blockade line until the Inquisition went after them. Very few of us were lucky enough to live a peaceful life.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: The Inquisition rounded up a lot of people. People that they deemed threats, and rightfully so.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Um, are you sure?

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: That sounds kinda scary. If I remember correctly, you're an Ægirian too, aren't you, Purestream?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yeah, but there are people of all races in Yan, so no one seemed to mind. I haven't heard of Ægirians being barred from any official positions, either. Everyone's equal.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Now that I think about it, Rhodes Island doesn't care much about races, either. When I first got here, everyone really took good care of me. Just like Mr. Elysium! He helped me out on my first field mission!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Me too. On my last mission, some enemies got the drop on me. It's all thanks to Mr. Elysium that I'm still here... Thank you very much.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, no need to thank me. I get reassigned to different teams pretty often. We're all teammates, so we should help each other out.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Even so, I must still thank you for your kindness.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Absinthe, you're always so stubborn when it comes to these things. I have way too many people around me like that...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Such as that captain of yours?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yes, she's one of those people, but have you ever noticed you're very stubborn yourself?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: The captain doesn't talk much, but she looks so cool... and I'm a little embarrassed to say this, but I'm actually a little scared of her.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I get it, I get it. She does look very scary.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But, you know, she just looks scary and doesn't try to talk to others much. She's actually very easy to talk to.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The next time you see her, maybe you should try saying hi to her. She may not look it, but it'll make her really happy. I guarantee it.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It sounds like you two really get along.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, I guess we kind of do... After all, she was the one who saved my life.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Besides, she can't get by without my help. If it wasn't for that, I would've been a Messenger, traveling all around the world right now.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, being popular has its own set of problems.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I seem to remember she's on a solo mission right now?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: And you're saying she can't get by without your help?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...This mission's different! Only she alone could handle such an infiltration mission. I'd just blow her cover.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I don't think she has ever teamed up with anyone before me, right? It was pretty terrible at first. She even used to beat me up just because she thought I was annoying. Don't you think that's cruel?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Her Arts are really something else. I took a single blow and it knocked me out of my senses so terribly that I didn't even know how to get home. It took me a while until I remembered who I was!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: It affected your consciousness... and memories? I didn't know Arts could be so dangerous.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: And that someone here at Rhodes Island has Arts like that...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Uh, yeah, it's not something we talk about often. It's technically classified information, so don't tell anyone else, okay?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Anyway, you should try to be more casual. We all get along with each other here. If there's anything you don't understand, come find me. I'll be happy to help you.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: More or less what he just said.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You don't need to force yourself, though. Just go on at your own pace. Anyone will be happy to help you should you run into any problems.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yep, that's right. Don't push yourself too hard!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, perfect! Sinthe, why don't you come to our party? You two as well, Mr. Elysium, Mr. Thorns. I'll be making lots of food from back home!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: The festival only happens once a year. Be sure to eat your fill!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well! That certainly gives me something to look forward to!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hehe, and do look forward to it. I promise you won't be disappointed~!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: A city in gray, drab colors. Depressing. Boring. Is that all?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Is that how you see that place?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well... my situation isn't quite like yours.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I really don't have much to say about that place. It was a simple and boring place to me, and that really is it for me.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Besides, I couldn't possibly have gone into the details. One of them is still a child.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't tell me you've forgotten.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The girl is still a student, and she's in a pretty cheerful mood because of the festival coming up. Let's not dampen her spirits.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Home... huh? I wonder what it's like now.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I wonder if it's still packed with buildings, and the wind is still so humid, with that salty scent to it? Are the streets there still empty, and everyone there's as quiet as they've always been?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Who are you asking? How would I know?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, you're right.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Tell me, brother, do you think we'll ever have a chance to go back, having run away from that place?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I don't think I want to go back.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But I can't help but think that, perhaps one day... I'll go back.
